newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: PM DOES NOT RULE OUT ENERGY PRICE HIKE.
newsitem.headline: PM DOES NOT RULE OUT ENERGY PRICE HIKE.

text.p: Lithuanian Prime Minister Gediminas Vagnorius said on Thursday that the government might consider raising energy prices this year but not before the end of the current winter season.
"We shall not raise prices before the end of this heating season," Vagnorius said at a news conference.
In response to a question about a possible hike this year, Vagnorius said "we will see in the fall..."
The International Monetary Fund and the World Bank have both urged Lithuania to raise its energy prices for consumers to realistic levels.
